description: Hand-built retrieval test set for the FATF Recommendations (Feb 2012). A retrieved chunk counts as relevant if its page span intersects `gold_pages`. `keywords` is an auxiliary lexical check used for qualitative inspection, not for the headline metrics. Gold pages were assigned by manually locating the operative/definitional text for each question in the source PDF.

questions.question: What is the definition of a beneficial owner?
What is the risk-based approach in the FATF Recommendations?
When should enhanced due diligence be applied?
What are the requirements for wire transfers under Recommendation 16?
Who are politically exposed persons (PEPs) and what measures apply to them?
What are the rules for cross-border correspondent banking relationships?
What does Recommendation 21 require regarding tipping-off and confidentiality?
What must financial institutions do regarding new technologies?
What are the record-keeping requirements for financial institutions?
When must a suspicious transaction report be filed?
What measures apply to cash couriers and cross-border transportation of currency?
Which businesses count as designated non-financial businesses and professions (DNFBPs)?
What are the designated categories of offences for money laundering?
What is the customer due diligence threshold for occasional transactions?
What is required when relying on third parties to perform CDD?
